definition: Number of characters in the normalised URL string.
Number of characters in the hostname (excluding userinfo, port and brackets).
Count of '.' characters in the whole normalised URL.
Count of '-' characters in the whole normalised URL.
Count of non-alphanumeric characters that are not ordinary URL structure characters (see docs/FEATURES.md).
Count of digit characters in the whole normalised URL.
1 when the host is a literal IPv4/IPv6 address instead of a domain name, else 0.
1 when the URL contains '@' (userinfo before the real host), else 0.
1 when any documented obfuscation pattern is present (double slash in path, multiple '?', deep subdomain chain, or brand token in a lookalike host), else 0.
Number of host labels before the approximate registrable domain (0 for a bare domain or an IP host).
1 when the scheme is https, else 0. WEAK feature: HTTPS alone never means legitimate.
1 when the registrable domain is in the maintained static list of URL shorteners, else 0.
Case-insensitive substring count of login, verify, update, secure, account, banking and confirm in the URL.
1 when an explicit port other than 80/443 is present, else 0.
1 when percent-encoded (%xx) or legacy %uXXXX sequences are present, else 0.
